title: Grave Offerings
description: A row of weathered headstones stands along a cobbled path, each grave adorned with fresh offerings that someone — or something — placed here recently. Bundles of dark flowers, small leather pouches of coin, and woven grass charms sit atop the mossy stone. The air smells of turned earth and wilted petals.

choices.label: Take the coins
choices.description: The dead have no use for gold, but the living do.

outcomes.text: You pocket the coin pouches quickly. The graves remain silent — whoever left these won't miss them.
A generous take. One pouch holds twice the gold you expected, along with a small gem wrapped in cloth.
As you grab the last pouch, a spectral hand erupts from the grave and rakes across your arm. The dead take their offerings seriously.

choices.label: Collect the grave dust
choices.description: Fine dust from freshly tended graves holds potent alchemical properties.

outcomes.text: You kneel beside the graves and carefully brush the dust into pouches. The headstones watch you impassively.
The dust here is unusually pure — the grave tenders clearly keep these plots well maintained. An excellent yield.
A whiff of the dust makes your head spin and your vision blur. You gather what you can before staggering away.

choices.label: Respect the dead
choices.description: Grave robbing carries its own kind of curse.

outcomes.text: You tip your head to the headstones and walk on. Some debts are not worth collecting.
